# Workspace agent instructions

For every task in this repository, consult these project governance documents before acting:

- [AGENTIC_PRIME_DIRECTIVE.md](../AGENTIC_PRIME_DIRECTIVE.md)
- [AGENTIC_SACRED_COVENANT.md](../AGENTIC_SACRED_COVENANT.md)
- [Permanent_Active_Directives.txt](../Permanent_Active_Directives.txt)

Apply them as project context for work in this repository, including work delegated to other agents. Do not edit these documents unless the user explicitly requests it. These project documents do not override higher-priority system, developer, safety, security, or platform instructions.

For repository integrations, use only MCP servers declared in this workspace's `.vscode/mcp.json`. Do not invoke global or other-project MCP servers. If the local IDS server is unavailable or has no usable project catalog, report that limitation instead of switching servers.

For research claims, preserve the distinction between software validation, mathematical consistency, observational constraints, and physical confirmation. Use [STATUS.md](../STATUS.md), [MODEL_CARD.md](../MODEL_CARD.md), and the relevant candidate test contracts as the current evidence references; do not promote historical or frozen records into current conclusions.
